what: The verifier that the archived artifact actually contains
why: The Zenodo DOI in CITATION.cff points at the 0.2.1 snapshot. Everything built after 2026-09-18 lives in the repository and in no archived artifact. Anyone who downloads the DOI and then reads a claim about S7-S18 would be misled, and the file exists so that the claim can be checked instead of remembered.
source_kind: Software Heritage snapshot a901225b50ae3fe84f9f878b8c0d6b0399867e64 (main), which is the revision named in CITATION.cff
how_measured: curl raw.githubusercontent.com at that revision; grep for record("Sxx" ...) and "id": "Sxx" in uibc_core/verify.py
limits_of_this_measurement: It measures the verifier's CHECK IDS, not the package lifecycle, the auditor, the red-team stages or the interoperability exports.
None of tools/outsider_audit.py, the outside kit, the verify endpoint or the AAC export existed at that revision.
A count of ids is not a count of behaviour: S1-S6 at that revision also had less coverage than S1-S6 today.
